seal.rule: Read ONCE, at MF's freeze. Exported and embedded, but no lab run and no read until MF's candidate is frozen (section 2.1).
seal.allowed_before_the_freeze: the export, its download, post_export_checks, the DINOv3 embed. NOT allowed: registering c20 in cohorts.json, `lab build`, `lab run`, `lab board`, `lab lost`, `lab page`, `harness run` or `harness evaluate` on c20; any fit, calibration map or cut that reads a c20 advert; any judge (LLM) run on c20 pairs; any operator look at a c20 group. MF's cut is chosen by stop rule (a) on c18 M1 and the c17 M4 read, never on c20.

seal.no_leak: No c20 read enters cohorts.json (group_reads) or the rulings (POST /autodedup/verdict) before MF's go / no-go is recorded in a second addendum. The reads are kept under /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/preregistrations/c20_reads/ until then.

read_protocol.frames: M4 frame = the groups MF forms that REF does not (groups_gained). M5 frame = the REF groups MF breaks up (autodedup/lab/page.py `splits`; an absorbed REF group is asked about through the MF group). Groups holding a flagged advert are left out of both frames.
read_protocol.draw: each frame sorted by its sorted member-id tuple, then random.Random(20260928).shuffle(frame), separately per frame with a fresh generator; the first 40 of each are read (all if fewer). The drawn keys are written to c20_reads/draw.json before the page is shown. Where a tool draws differently, this draw governs.
read_protocol.page: one private review page (B-i) per frame, 40 + 40 cards (the c20 part of RP4, about 35 minutes at ~25 s a card). Each card shows every member's portal link and stated facts and its decided pairs; it does not say which arm formed the group.
read_protocol.verdict: binary: 'One property' or 'Not one property'. A card left unanswered counts AGAINST MF: as fused in M4, as one property (a true group MF lost) in M5.
read_protocol.classification_D7: Pre-registered (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 2.2, decision D7): a group is FUSED when any two members state a different value of any fact (area, floor or its wording, disposition, price while co-live, part of town, room size in the body, unit designator, cellar or accessory, ...), UNLESS an operator ruling covers the pair, or an operator ruling on a convention covers the difference (identical units are one property; a floor-numbering convention). 'Inside the engine's tolerance' is not an excuse. Undecidable counts against the arm. Standing rulings apply: a rental is never one property with a sale; a flat is never one property with a commercial unit; image tags are never facts. The operator reads; the operator's read is final, and a 'One property' read against a stated difference is recorded with that difference.
read_protocol.wilson: shares are reported with the 95 % Wilson interval; 0 of 40 bounds the fused share at <= 8.8 %.

bars.A4: M4 on c20 with the production model file: 0 fused among the drawn MF-only groups under D7, undecidable counting as fused (section 2.5).
bars.A5: M4 vs M5 on c20: MF-only's one-property Wilson lower bound >= REF-only's (the M5 draw's one-property share read as REF's own-group precision), AND estimated true groups gained > lost = (MF-only groups x M4 one-property share) > (REF-only groups x M5 one-property share).
bars.A3: every fixture pair of the extended list (section 2.1) that lives in c20 kept apart; expected vacuous (the fixtures live in trial, c17, c18 and c6).
bars.readouts: computed once at the same opening, never bars on c20: M7, M9 (decide wall MF / REF), certain-duplicate recall (truth16.py) MF vs REF, re-post trains newly split. A6 stays descriptive (D11).
bars.not_computable_here: A1 and A2 (no operator rulings on c20), A7, A8, A9 (trial / c17 / c18 by definition).

refusal_rule: A4 failing (>= 1 fused MF-only group, or an unanswered card) or A5 failing REFUSES MF on this ground: MF does not ship as R2 in this cycle unless a fresh sealed cohort is cut and passes. A4's fused cards are read for their stated fact; a fix is a reader or tolerance counted against stop rule (b), and per 'second_read' it confirms on a fresh cohort, never on c20. A5 failing buys more labels only under stop rule (c).
verdict_forms: PASS (A4 and A5 pass, A3 holds), REFUSE (A4 or A5 fails, with the cards), VOID (post_export_checks flag > 1 %), NOT-MEASURABLE (a run, the production model file or the freeze addendum is missing).
